test_pandas_test_suite: test the pandas test suite by running pytest with default marks excluding slow, network, and db tests
test_pandas_doctests: test the pandas doctests by running --doctest-modules and --doctest-cython on all modules
test_pandas_custom_args: test the pandas test suite with custom pytest extra arguments passed as a list of strings
test_pandas_with_hypothesis: test the pandas test suite requiring hypothesis as an optional dependency for property-based tests
test_pandas_with_extra_marks: test the pandas test suite filtering by custom pytest marks provided via extra_args
